result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to an affiliate or qualifying successor; IBM requires Customer consent, subject to a reasonableness standard, and is absolutely prohibited from assigning to a Customer competitor. It adds no termination right for Customer change of control and otherwise retains the original allocation, including Customer’s continuing liability. The changes are targeted and professional, though the successor carve-out could be phrased more precisely as an assignment “in connection with” a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all Customer assets.
